text: Some female squids wear fake testicles to avoid the advancements of male squids. Female hummingbirds will also avoid harassment by dressing up like males. Female dragonflies will fake sudden death to avoid male advances. They will literally drop out of the sky so a man will stay away from them. And some female butterflies emit a chemical compared to a natural pepper spray to keep away men. Certain female insects will make themselves smell bad to keep male suitors away. And finally, some female humans are forced to buy intricate self-defense kits because men won't leave us alone. Look, I can play this game too. Female mantises eat the male in roughly 13 to 28% of encounters in the wild. During mating season, males can make up to 63% of what females eat. In some anglerfish, the male fuses into the female's body and gets absorbed until there's almost nothing left of him but a pair of gonads she can draw on later. Female topi antelopes chase males for sex so persistently that the males start refusing and fighting back. Current biology called it reversed sexual conflict. Males avoiding females who won't take no. Black widows are named after the habit. Honeybee drones mate once and die in the act. And the ones who miss out get thrown out of the hive by female workers to starve in arm. So what have I just proven about women? Nothing at all, because there are millions of species on this planet. And I can find a fact for almost any conclusion I want to present. Using animals to make moral claims about humans is ridiculous in either direction. Nature also contains cannibalism, infanticide, forced mating, and animals eating their own offspring. It is not an ethical instruction manual. Now, her underlying concern is not imaginary. Men do commit most serious violent crimes. Women have legitimate reasons to take precautions, particularly regarding sexual and intimate partner violence. Acknowledging that shouldn't be controversial. But most violent offenders are men does not mean most men are violent offenders. Most NBA players are men. That doesn't mean most men play in the NBA. The overwhelming majority of men are not violent criminals. And over time, violence has fallen enormously. According to FBI data, the US violent crime rate fell by 49% between 1993 and 2022. It then fell another 3% in 2023, 4.5% in 2024, and approximately 9% in 2025, the largest annual decline in nearly 90 years. And when somebody does become violent, who is disproportionately expected to confront them, restrain them, and arrest them? Other men. According to the FBI's latest police employee data, about 85% of reported law enforcement officers in 2025 were men. I am not claiming that men alone cause the crime decline. The causes are complicated, and female officers, victims advocates, medical workers, and many others also protect people. But if men collectively inherit the guilt for every male criminal, why would they not collectively inherit credit for every male officer, rescuer, or bystander who stops one? Because collective guilt and collective credit are both absurd. Condemn violent men. Protect women. Prosecute offenders. But stop using horny insects to portray half of humanity as a predator classic.
